title: The Datasec expert content is not supplied: keep it DRAFT and leave gaps?
bluf: Override of the prior-ruling gate: the gate matched only the word 'content'. Card hpsmpoc-hp-content-gaps-tell-hp-1021 (a) ruled whether to tell HP in the cover note that HPSMPOC-94, -47, -48 wait on HP's content; this card is about nine different tickets (31, 37, 44, 46, 87, 55, 393, 394, 395) that wait on a Datasec expert, and asks who supplies them. Card hpsmpoc-draft-content-show-or-hide-1021 (a) ruled that DRAFT content is shown to HP marked DRAFT, which option A below keeps. Your 29 Oct ruling 'gather those' covered 393 and 394 as held-out pieces but did not say who supplies them. Overlaps stated so you can veto: 87 (shown DRAFT, 21 Oct) and 37 (scenarios approved as the DRAFT demo set, 4 Oct). Nine tickets wait on content only a Datasec expert can supply: the rules content, expected-result reconciliation, report language and disclaimers, HP policy examples, trial-run metrics, the customer question set, the Framework alignment table, the five independent-assessment principles, and audience testing. The project rule is that nothing security-related is invented. Recommend: everything stays labelled DRAFT, the unsupplied views stay out, and no expert sign-off is claimed. Default if you do not tap: option A, at 10:00 AEDT today (2026-11-10). Tickets: HPSMPOC-31, HPSMPOC-37, HPSMPOC-44, HPSMPOC-46, HPSMPOC-87, HPSMPOC-55, HPSMPOC-393, HPSMPOC-394, HPSMPOC-395
